summary: Decodes 24-bit packed RGB888 source texels (one byte per channel plus an ignored byte) into 32-bit float RGBA output, four floats per pixel with alpha written as 1.0. The source texel address is computed from the base pixel-data pointer (this+0x18) plus a3 times the slice stride (this+0x1054) plus a2 times the row pitch (this+0x1050), for a pixel count at this+0x1058. Each of the three color channels is scaled by 0.0039215689 (1/255). When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup (0x00507845) is invoked on the decoded output buffer afterwards.

operations.description: Source byte address v4 = *(this+0x18) + a3 * *(this+0x1054) + a2 * *(this+0x1050) locates the first texel of the requested row and slice in the source pixel-data buffer.
Iterate while v4 < i where i = v4_start + 4 * *(this+0x1058); each iteration consumes 4 source bytes (three color bytes plus one ignored byte) and emits 4 output floats.
Red channel: a4[0] = byte(v4+2) * 0.0039215689; the scale factor is supplied by the read-only float globals flt_59E460 and flt_5ADB14.
Blue channel: the low byte of the dword at v4 is scaled by 0.0039215689 and written to a4[2] after the output pointer advances by 4 floats.
Alpha channel: the loop-increment write stores 1.0 to a4[3] for every emitted pixel.
When the flag at this+0x10 is non-zero, the decoded output buffer is post-processed.
ContactManifoldCleanup(this, &a4[-4 * *(this+0x1058)]) runs on the guard path, receiving the start of the decoded float RGBA buffer.
